The structure of Li₂Mn₄Sn₂O₁₂ (reduced formula LiMn₂SnO₆) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 20 atoms per unit cell distributed over 7 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral coordination for Li, Mn, and Sn centers, each surrounded by six O neighbors, with Mn–O distances of 1.99–2.08 Å. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between MnO₆ and SnO₆ octahedra and between LiO₆ and MnO₆ octahedra, while LiO₆ and SnO₆ octahedra share edges. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 20 sites.
